verified_behaviors: The candidate source map is validated before importing its normalizer; module paths must resolve inside the frozen package.
Benchmark hardware raw/canonical identifiers, runtime profile v2 raw/canonical identifiers, and launch profile v2 raw/canonical identifiers must encode the same physical GPU.
Actual configure_cuda raw/canonical identifiers are validated and actual canonical UUID remains compared to the immutable training hardware.
Current-process PID, wrapper-entry hash, target path/hash, exact arguments, preimport assertions, environment, runtime flags and distribution bindings are retained.
Numerical replay, checkpoint loading, all-20 coverage, batch regrouping, intervals and ownership rules were not changed by this delta.
